_comment: RA-16 — Inspector Save button. Implementer adds data-testid='inspector-save' to the button + ensures previewState.commit(nodeId) copies to source store and clears the buffer. Depends on EBR2-E-01 / E-02 having shipped (usePreviewStateStore + Inspector overlay path).

steps.js: (() => { const set = window.__PRISM_EDITOR_SET_VIEW_MODE__; if (typeof set === 'function') set('canvas'); return 'canvas'; })()

(() => { const stores = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__; const ed = stores.graphEditor.getState(); const src = stores.graphSource.getState(); const node = src.nodes[0]; ed.selectNode(node.nodeId); ed.openInspector(); ed.setEditorMode('edit'); stores.previewState.getState().set(node.nodeId, { caption: 'SAVE-COMMIT-TEST' }); return node.nodeId; })()

(() => { const stores = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__; const ed = stores.graphEditor.getState(); const src = stores.graphSource.getState(); const previewApi = stores.previewState.getState(); const nodeId = ed.selectedNodeId; const node = src.nodes.find((n) => n.nodeId === nodeId); return node && node.caption === 'SAVE-COMMIT-TEST' && previewApi.isDirty(nodeId) === false; })()
